independence.meaning: Criteria frozen before new peer candidate proposals; prior completed panel knowledge is available.

scope: Planning admission, not theorem certification or a promise of success. No implementation in this stage.

bounded-mathematical-attempt.publicMeaning: A precisely stated finite or otherwise controlled mathematical question admitted for a bounded attempt; never guaranteed solved.
admitOnlyIf: Objects, parameter domain, quantifiers, coordinate/gauge equivalence, observable and conclusion are explicit.
At least one proof route or exact counterexample route fits the declared resource cap.
All imported results have exact hypotheses that are independently available; the desired conclusion is not assumed.
Successful completion is a proof/counterexample on the declared domain, not a sampled numerical agreement.
The objective differs substantively from already completed controls.

engineering-or-verification-task.publicMeaning: Build, integrate, instrument, reproduce or formally check an already specified finite result. This can improve assurance without creating new mathematics.
admitOnlyIf: Target artifact, runtime/toolchain, dependency source, input contract and observable acceptance are named.
A meaningful deliberately wrong control is rejected by the actual execution.
Availability of toolchain/data and an independent review route are established or listed as admission prerequisites.
No compiler success is promoted to semantic fidelity or physical correctness.

experimental-hypothesis.publicMeaning: A falsifiable question requiring new calibrated physical measurements; no simulation-only closure.
admitOnlyIf: Effect and null are operationally distinct after nuisance parameters and calibration uncertainty.
Apparatus boundary, inputs, reservoirs, measurement operator and randomization/control plan are specified.
Finite model simulation is labeled a design aid rather than physical evidence.
Instrument access, uncertainty budget, stopping rule and empirical decision threshold are prerequisites.

grand-open-problem.publicMeaning: A long-horizon unresolved target, not presently claimed solvable by the panel.
admitOnlyIf: Remaining bridge is stated without silently strengthening hypotheses or changing target.
Any funded near-term subtask is separately classified and has bounded acceptance.
Repeated success on toys is not represented as progress on a missing continuum/global premise.

park-or-reject.publicMeaning: Missing decisive data, imported assumption, new objective, resource feasibility or a test capable of distinguishing the desired claim.

noncircularityRules: Do not assume a uniform gap to advertise proving that same uniform gap.
Do not assume complete boundary data when proposed measurements are finitely many peaks.
Do not use a capacity theorem as a bound on ergotropy without an explicit valid reduction.
Do not assume costless preparation, correlations, cooling, gain calibration or reset to infer a closed energy cycle.
An external theorem result is usable only after exact statement/hypothesis mapping; a badge or title is insufficient.

noveltyPolicy.knownIdentity: State established result newly reproduced or applied.
noveltyPolicy.newCodeOrProtocol: State project implementation/protocol, not a discovery.
noveltyPolicy.newLemmaCandidate: No novelty claim until bounded literature/prior-art comparison and proof review.
noveltyPolicy.newPhysicalEffect: No discovery claim without calibrated measurement and independent replication.

adversarialReviewRules: Require one control that the attractive wrong conclusion would wrongly accept.
Unknown or missing evidence causes abstention, not a default pass.
Matched metadata is eligible for proof review only.
Separate global uniqueness, local Jacobian rank and practical noise conditioning.
Separate physical gauge conventions from genuine distinguishable parameters.
Report proposal downgrades and stop outcomes rather than expanding scope to avoid failure.
resourceRule: Use capped person/agent-hours, compute, memory and dependency/instrument prerequisites as estimates. State what causes stopping before the cap. No indefinite search or recursive agent escalation.
stopRule: Exactly review, planning round1 and adaptive planning round2; no coding, new simulation or experiment in this review task. Await advisor admission before critiquing peer plans.
